voice: An oily, wheedling stool pigeon and huckster: boastful, self-serving, and quick to flirt with 'toots,' but cowardly and evasive when cornered. Heavy contractions, 1920s slang, and malapropisms; a light touch of accent ('ain't,' 'ya,' 'gonna,' 'dunno,' dropped g's) but no phonetic respellings such as 'dat' or 'hoid.' Flirting sits between vanilla and the P2-08 rewrite. Maintainer direction, 2026-10-14; supersedes the earlier P2-08 Ziggy voice.

entries.text: Well, ain't you the hoity-toity dame these days? I almost didn't recognize ya with your clothes on.
Ziggy's my moniker. You gonna pretend ya don't know me?
I ain't jokin'. You're Yvette Delacroix. I'd know that figure of yours anywhere.
Oh...I get it. You're worried one of these high-hats is gonna hear us, right? Okay, I'm clued in. We can talk later.
Hey, now, watch how ya say that, O'Riley. I don't like the sound of it.
Only by low-class types, O'Riley. By the way, ain't you afraid of bein' seen with me?
I'm a big patron of the arts. That's the kind of high-class guy I am.
Umm...HEY, ain't that the Countess I see over there? I gotta talk to her.
Yeah, no kiddin'. The walls got ears around here. And so do certain nosy reporters, if ya know what I mean.
So that's when ya heisted it, right?
Boy, that Yvette, she's some dish, ain't she?
Yeah, we Americans come up with some swell sayings, don't we?
